verdict.rationale: Adyen documents agent-platform integrations that run the full ACP and UCP checkout flows for merchants. An agent call creates a checkout session, and Adyen returns the UCP envelope, totals and fulfillment options. Adyen also orchestrates stock, tax and shipping, and the merchant cart API defines session lifecycle steps such as commit and cancel. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented update-session/cart-modification call in the evidence (updating is only implied by 'full checkout flow'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
